metadata.description: Write test data through a RUNNING baseline release's HTTP API and save what the verify step needs in the state file (#475, ADR-018 §5). Needs QAUTH_BASE_URL, QAUTH_UPGRADE_DATABASE_URL, QAUTH_UPGRADE_STATE and QAUTH_UPGRADE_ALLOW_WRITES=1. See apps/upgrade-test/README.md.
After the upgrade, check that the data the populate step wrote still works on the new server: tokens, refresh, consent, API key, password. Same variables as populate.

Version-agnostic smoke tests: a fresh user, client, sign-in, consent, tokens and API key on the running server. Runs against the new server after the upgrade and against the baseline server on the migrated database (the rolling-upgrade leg).
